qualification_driver.purpose: confined rootless clients with PIDFD_GET_USER_NAMESPACE disabled
qualification_driver.source:
import importlib.util,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/usr/share/doc/sigrund/namespace-phase4')
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('installed',root/'verify-installed.py');api=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(api)
operator=api.Approver(Path('/var/lib/sigrund-phase4-qualification/approver'));cases=[]
try:
 for target in ('host','registered:container-b'):
  args=['--target',target,'--security-profile','host-baseline' if target=='host' else 'namespace-selinux-v1']
  args+=['--target-uid','65534','--target-gid','65534','--cwd','/'] if target=='host' else ['--account','phase4_service','--cwd','/srv/service']
  command=['/usr/bin/unshare','--map-auto','--map-root-user','/usr/local/libexec/sigrund-phase4/peer-auth-compat','exec','/usr/bin/sigrun','--socket',api.SOCKET,*args,'--',api.TOOL]
  process=subprocess.Popen(api.requester('phase4req','sigrund-phase4-compat-client',command),stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
  try:
   review=operator.confirm(process);execution=api.execution_id(review);out,err=process.communicate(timeout=15)
   assert process.returncode==0,(out,err)
   assert b'destination='+('host' if target=='host' else 'B').encode() in out
   rows=api.assert_execution(execution,namespace=target!='host')
   cases.append({'target':target,'exec_id':execution,'stdout':out.decode(),'consumed':api.consumed(execution),'job_removed':not api.job(execution).exists()})
  finally:
   if process.poll() is None:
    subprocess.run(['systemctl','stop','sigrund-phase4-compat-client.service'],capture_output=True);process.kill();process.communicate(timeout=5)
 print(json.dumps({'passed':True,'cases':cases},indent=2))
finally:
 operator.close()
